description: Transpower publishes line spans between towers, poles or terminations. The description says the geometry represents the centreline between structures and covers overhead transmission lines. Metadata includes asset location, status, description and length fields. The transmission-line documentation identifies spans as a subset with structure-to-structure information. These geometric segments do not establish a solved electrical network, circuit parameters or current operational capacity. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing Transpower transmission-lines record.
